faqs.q: How fast do I get paid?
faqs.a: Same day. The moment attendance is confirmed with the employer's 4-digit code, your escrowed pay lands in your Tally wallet and can be withdrawn to your bank.
No. You can sign up, apply, and confirm shifts over USSD (*347*82#) or WhatsApp. A smartphone unlocks the full app, but it's never required.
A verifiable record built from completed jobs, on-time arrival, and repaid loans. A higher score unlocks better jobs and real, affordable credit.

faqs.q: Can I use Tally in my language?
faqs.a: Yes — the app, USSD and WhatsApp work in English, Nigerian Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo. Pick your language once and it's saved for next time, across your devices.

faqs.a: When you fund a job the pay is held in a dedicated escrow account — not sent yet. It's released only when the worker confirms attendance with your code, so you never pay for a no-show.

faqs.q: How do I find good workers?
faqs.a: Tally suggests NIN-verified workers with real track records and ratings, matched to your job and location. You invite the ones you want; they confirm.

faqs.q: What does it cost to hire?
faqs.a: A small, transparent fee per completed hire — shown before you confirm, with no monthly minimums.

faqs.q: Can I post jobs in a local language?
faqs.a: Yes. Post in the language you prefer; the hiring interface works in English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo, and one-tap translation of posts for workers is on our roadmap.

faqs.q: Why should I log every sale?
faqs.a: Each logged sale becomes part of a verifiable record — and that record is what qualifies you for stock loans. The more consistent your sales, the more capital you can access.
The full POS, inventory, and business toolkit are on our roadmap and clearly marked Coming Soon. You can start building your sales record today so you're ready on day one.
Once your sales history qualifies you, you can access a stock advance sized to your record, repaid as you sell. On-time repayment grows your score for larger limits.

faqs.q: Will the POS support local languages?
faqs.a: Yes — the coming POS, receipts and product listings are being built multilingual from day one, in English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo.

getPaid.q: How do I get paid for a shift?
getPaid.a: After you're matched to a job, apply to get a 4-digit confirmation code. On site, the employer confirms your attendance — that releases the escrowed pay straight into your Tally wallet, which you can withdraw to your bank.

tallyScore.a: It's a reliability score built from your real activity — shifts completed, on-time rate, sales logged, and loans repaid. A higher score unlocks better jobs and larger loans. Every point is explained on the My standing page.

logSale.q: Why should I log every sale?
logSale.a: Each logged sale becomes part of a verifiable track record. That record is what qualifies you for stock loans — the more consistent your sales, the larger the working capital you can access.

escrowProtect.q: How does escrow protect my money?
escrowProtect.a: When you fund a job, the pay is held in a dedicated escrow account — not sent to the worker yet. It's only released when the worker confirms attendance with their code, so you never pay for a no-show.

hireWorkers.q: How do I hire reliable workers?
hireWorkers.a: Post a job, fund its escrow, then tap Find workers. We match workers by skill and reliability score, so you see people with a proven track record first.

loans.a: Loan eligibility is based on your Tally Score. Approved loans disburse to your payout account, and repaying on time raises your score — unlocking larger limits next time.

verify.q: How do I verify my identity?
verify.a: Go to Verify identity, enter your 11-digit NIN, and add a payout bank account. We confirm the account name before saving and store sensitive numbers encrypted — we never keep the raw values.

dataSafe.a: Yes. Sensitive identifiers like your NIN are hashed, payout details are confirmed before use, and security and payment alerts are always delivered so you're never in the dark about your money.

Security.title: Your money and your data, protected
Security.lede: Trust is the product. Here's exactly how we keep funds safe, identities private, and both sides of every job accountable.

escrow.title: Escrow-protected funds
escrow.body: Employer funds are held with a CBN-licensed partner bank and released only when attendance is confirmed. No confirmation, no release.

encryption.title: Encryption everywhere
encryption.body: Traffic is protected with TLS in transit, and sensitive identifiers like your NIN are encrypted at rest — never stored in the clear.

access.title: Least-privilege access
access.body: Access to production data is role-based, logged, and limited to what each task strictly requires. No standing access to your records.

rails.title: Licensed payment rails
rails.body: Payouts run through licensed payment providers over regulated infrastructure — the same rails trusted by Nigerian banks.

fraud.title: Fraud & anomaly checks
fraud.body: Attendance codes, verified identities, and behavioural checks reduce no-shows, impersonation, and payout abuse on both sides.

ndpr.title: NDPR-aligned by design
ndpr.body: We collect the minimum we need, tell you why, and honour your data rights under Nigeria's Data Protection Regulation.

Security.disclosureSubtitle: We welcome reports from security researchers and treat them with priority.
Security.disclosureBody: Please email <email>security@tally.ng</email> with details and steps to reproduce. Give us a reasonable window to fix the issue before public disclosure — and please don't access or modify data that isn't yours.
Security.ctaBody: Every payout, identity, and record is handled with the care it deserves.

Footer.tagline: Tally turns informal work, sales, and payments into a verifiable economic identity — unlocking same-day pay, better jobs, and real credit for Nigeria's hardest workers.
